title: SBA 7(a) & Debt Architecture
rules: SBA 7(a) Loan parameters: Up to $5,000,000, 10-year amortization, Prime + 2.75% typical rate.
Equity Injection Optimization: Combine 10% cash down with a 10-15% seller note on full standby to minimize personal equity risk.
DSCR Requirement: Lenders require a minimum Debt Service Coverage Ratio of 1.25x. Ensure free cash flow covers debt payments with a 25% safety buffer.
